VideoCallInsight.name: VideoCallInsight
VideoCallInsight.description: Represents the video call insight data associated with a video call. Each record represents the call insight of a specific recording or transcript within a call.

EngagementInsightType.description: Required. The unique identifier of the platform setup entity that defines the configuration for this engagement insight type.

GenerationDateTime.description: Required. The timestamp when the call insight was generated.

InsightConfigName.description: The name of the insight configuration, or category, used to classify the insight.

InsightLanguage.description: Required. The language associated with the insight type. Each insight type is currently limited to a single language. If the same insight type is mapped to a different language, a new insight type is created.

InsightModel.description: Required. The category of the insight type.

InsightOccurenceCount.description: The number of times a particular insight occurred in the transcript.

InsightSubject.description: The specific text, phrase, or subject identified in the video call transcript that serves as the basis for the insight.

InsightText.description: The text content of the insight derived from the video call transcript.

Name.description: The display name of the insight type.

Scope.description: Required. The scope of the insight type.

VideoCallId.description: Required. ID of the associated parent VideoCall.

VideoCallRecordingId.description: Required. ID of the associated parent VideoCallRecording.

VideoCallTranscriptId.description: Required. ID of the associated VideoCallTranscript record.

VideoCallInsight.accessRules: the Conversation Insights for Sales permission set
